szx_process_batch.intro: Execute the full SZX data processing pipeline: upload a dataset zip, run batch processing (M5), generate project-level plots (M2) and AI reports (M8). Returns combined MD reports and saves 'rendered_points.png' and a performance CSV named after the batch ID to the workspace.

dirname.description: The directory name under 'files/' containing the raw data to be processed.

file_service.intro: Save, read, upload-and-validate, or list files under the shared workspace. Prefer the `method` field to choose behavior: `uploadAndValidate` → UI prompts upload then validates; `write` → create/overwrite with content; `read` → read file; `list` → list files. If `method` is omitted, behavior falls back to upload+validate>write>read>list inference.

input.content:
# Next steps
- collect data
- run baseline

method.description: Explicit operation: uploadAndValidate (prompts user upload then validate), write (create/overwrite), read (preview text file), or list (list workspace files). Optional; defaults to inference if omitted.

filename.description: Optional desired save name under workspace; if omitted, the uploaded file name is used. For read/write, still required.

content.description: Content to write into the file; if omitted and filename is provided, the agent will try to read the file.

validation.description: Optional validation rules for an already-uploaded file (front-end saves file under the workspace before calling this). When provided, the agent validates instead of saving or reading.

allowed_extensions.description: Allowed file extensions (e.g., ['csv', 'txt']). Dots are optional.

csv_headers.description: Expected CSV header row; must match exactly if provided.

merge_csv_files.intro: Merge multiple CSV files with identical headers: verify existence and header consistency, concatenate them vertically, remove duplicates, optionally limit the number of data rows, and save the merged result. Returns the new filename and output dimensions.

csv_files.description: List of CSV filenames to merge (must exist in the predefined directory).

line_num.description: (Optional) Limit the number of data rows (excluding header). Defaults to include all.

ratio_generator.intro: Generate reagent volume tables (mL) based on a fixed base volume (default 50 mL) or load an existing percentage table. Supports stepwise enumeration or random sampling, and allows appending fixed-volume reagent columns. Ensure the total reagent volume does not exceed 30 mL (to be validated manually).

steps.description: Sequential list of actions; each step is either 'ratio' or 'add_reagent'. Repetition allowed.

action.description: 'ratio' generates/loads a percentage table; 'add_reagent' appends a fixed-volume column.

reagents.description: Required only for 'ratio' when generating new combinations.

min.description: Minimum percentage per reagent (for 'ratio' generation only).

max.description: Maximum percentage per reagent (for 'ratio' generation only).

sampling.description: 'full' enumerates all combinations; 'random' selects a subset (for 'ratio' only).

sample_n.description: If sampling='random', how many combinations to generate.

total_volume.description: Base volume (mL) used to convert percentage to mL.

percent_csv.description: Load an existing percentage CSV instead of generating new ratios ('ratio' only).

value.description: Fixed reagent volume in mL ('add_reagent' only).

rows.description: Specifies the number of output rows when all steps are 'add_reagent'; not needed if any 'ratio' step exists.

synthesis_expert.intro: Provide literature-based synthesis guidance: act like consulting a real human synthesis expert. The user must clearly describe the target compound, objectives/constraints, equipment capabilities, controllable conditions, existing methods, and uncertainties. The more context, the more accurate the guidance.

examples.question: I want to synthesize MOF-5 with high crystallinity using my available solvothermal reactor and automated liquid handling system. My equipment includes a programmable furnace (up to 500°C), a glovebox for inert gas work, and a UV photoreactor. I have zinc nitrate, terephthalic acid, DMF, and ethanol. I can control reaction temperature from 20–200°C and reaction time precisely. I found a general solvothermal method in literature but I am unsure about the washing and activation steps. Please provide step-by-step, literature-backed synthesis guidance adapted to my setup.
Continue advising on the MOF-5 synthesis optimization we discussed earlier. Please refine the activation step.

question.description: A complete synthesis request containing the target compound, goals/constraints, equipment and capabilities, available reagents, environmental control, prior attempts and results, and specific questions.

session_id.description: (Optional) Resume an existing RAGFlow session; omit to create a new session. The response always returns the active session_id.

shell_exec.intro: Execute a Bash command in the Agent's working directory using `bash -lc`, and return its output. Optional timeout, stdin, and environment variables supported.

command.description: The Bash command to execute (interpreted by `bash -lc`).

synthesis_robot.intro: Execute synthesis steps through predefined robotic workstations: solution-preparation / centrifuge-purification / ultrasonic-treatment / oven-station / electrochemistry-station. Each step must include step_id, workstation_id, matching parameters, and batch_time_s. Parameter fields must exactly match the corresponding workstation definition. Workstations may be repeated or omitted.

ml_training_agent.intro: Merge the percentage ratio CSV and performance CSV (with 'Index'/'Performance' columns) by Index, normalize data, and perform model training and prediction. Requires the user to upload 'theoretical_xlsx' (with sheets: 'metals' and 'params') beforehand. Output file: predict_percent_{uuid}.csv. The 'iteration' parameter starts at 0 and increments per round.

ratio_percent_csv.description: Filename of the existing percentage ratio CSV (with header).

performance_csv.description: Filename of the performance CSV containing 'Index' and 'Performance' columns.

theoretical_xlsx.description: Excel workbook containing sheets named 'metals' and 'params'. Must be uploaded and accessible before invocation.

iteration.description: Iteration counter for the current training/experiment round; starts at 0 and increments by 1.

protocol_converter.intro: Convert manual experimental steps into automated robotic workflow steps. Uses RAG to retrieve workstation capabilities and generates structured workflow steps compatible with synthesis_robot agent. Supports session_id for continuing and refining conversions across multiple requests.

examples.manual_steps: Prepare metal nitrate solutions and combine them, add alkaline solution in one portion, and stir vigorously for 30 minutes to complete precipitation and age at 60 °C for 24 h, centrifuge at 6000 rpm for 3 min and collect the precipitate, wash with deionized water and repeat washing–centrifugation three times, then prepare catalyst ink and perform CV/LSV tests.
Modify step 3 to use 90°C instead of 80°C

manual_steps.description: Manual experimental procedure description to be converted into automated workflow steps. Should include all relevant details: reagents, volumes, temperatures, times, operations, etc.

session_id.description: (Optional) Resume an existing conversion session; omit to create a new session. The response always returns the active session_id for continuing the conversation.
